description: Convert Polygon native USDC into USDC.e. This is owner-signed, same-chain, may receive gas assistance, and normally happens automatically inside fund_market.

amount_usd.description: Amount to swap. Defaults to the entire native USDC balance.

idempotency_key.description: Required workflow replay key. Reuse it after any timeout or restart.

resume_reconciliation.description: Set true only when resuming this exact interrupted workflow after reconciling its submitted transaction hash.

name: swap_native_usdc
